items.text: **`Core\Time\Instant::in`** — owes about, examples, hostile, perf, tests (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`). Its card is `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/time.rs:1239` and its body `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/time.rs:4464`. It returns a `DateTime`, so the examples need `Core\Time\Zone::of` and a `DateTime` reader: read those two rows before writing. The compareTo and minus proofs under `docs/examples/core/Time-Instant/` are the sibling shape. Then run `bun nv proofs --owed` for the goal's list; if `in` was the last item, close the goal.
